Venue: Biconomy.com
Headline: 🏆 MON Trading Competition — Share 700,000 MON!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Dear Biconomy Users,
The MON Trading Competition is here!
## Trade MON/USDT on Biconomy and compete for a share of the 700,000 MON prize pool!
## 📅Activity time
## November 24 — November 30, 2026 (UTC)
## 📝 How to Participate
1. Create or log in to your Biconomy account
2. Register for the campaign: Join Now
3. Trade MON_USDT during the event period
⚠️ You MUST register via the form to be eligible.
## 🏁 Competition Rules
## Ranking Calculation
- Ranking is based on total eligible MON/USDT trading volume (Buy + Sell) during the campaign.
- Only filled orders count toward trading volume. Cancelled or unfilled orders are excluded.
- Tie-breaker: If two or more users have the same eligible trading volume, the user who reaches that volume first will rank higher.
## Eligibility
- Minimum cumulative MON/USDT trading volume: 500 USDT
- Complete at least 10 filled MON/USDT trades during the campaign.
- Registration via form completed
## 🎁 Prize Distribution (700,000 MON):
RANKING | PRIZE | Minimum Trading Volume
🥇 1st Place | 112,000 MON | 10,000 USDT
🥈 2nd Place | 77,000 MON | 8,000 USDT
🥉 3rd Place | 35,000 MON | 6,000 USDT
4th-10th Place | Share 196,000 MON by Trading Volume | 3,000 USDT
11th – 30th Place | Share 280,000 MON by Trading Volume | 500 USDT
Qualified users will share 700,000 MON based on their trading volume rankings.
Your Reward = (Your Eligible Trading Volume ÷ Total Eligible Trading Volume of All Qualified Users in the Same Ranking Group) × Corresponding Prize Pool
## Notes
1.You must complete the campaign sign-up on this page to be eligible to participate.
2. Users will be ranked based on their total eligible MON/USDT trading volume (Buy + Sell) during the campaign period on Biconomy.
3. All rewards will be distributed within 7 business days after the campaign ends.
4. Biconomy reserves the right to disqualify accounts involved in wash trading, self-trading, market manipulation, multi-account abuse, or other fraudulent activities. Such trades will not count toward campaign rankings or rewards.
5. Biconomy reserves the right to the final interpretation of this campaign.

Venue: Biconomy.com
Headline: 🏆 LISTA Futures Carnival · Trade & Win Up to 2,130 USDT!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Dear Biconomy Users,
The LISTA Futures Carnival is officially live! Trade LISTAUSDT Perpetual Futures, complete campaign tasks, and unlock tiered rewards worth up to 2,130 USDT.
Trade LISTAUSDT Perpetual Futures, reach trading volume milestones, complete campaign tasks, and earn more rewards throughout the campaign.
## 📅 Campaign Period
November 24 — December 01, 2026 (UTC)
## 🎁 Total Prize Pool
Up to 2,130 USDT in Futures Coupons
- Task Rewards: Up to 110 USDT
LISTA Futures Trading Milestone: Up to 2,020 USDT
## 💠 Trading Pair
LISTA Perpetual Futures
## How to Join
- Register or log in to your Biconomy account.
- Complete campaign tasks and trade LISTAUSDT Perpetual Futures during the campaign.
- Unlock trading volume tiers to earn Futures Coupons — the more you trade, the more you win.
## Task Rewards (Up to 110 USDT)
Task | Reward
Cumulative Deposit ≥ 100 USDT | 5 USDT Percentage Deduction Coupon
Cumulative Deposit ≥ 200 USDT | 50 USDT Futures Coupon
Invited Friends ≥ 1 | 5 USDT Percentage Deduction Coupon
First LISTA USDT Futures Trade | 50 USDT Futures Coupon
Trading Volume Tiers (Up to 2,020 USDT)
Tier | Volume (USDT) | Reward (Futures Coupon)
1 | 3,000 | 50 USDT
2 | 5,000 | 80 USDT
3 | 8,000 | 100 USDT
4 | 10,000 | 150 USDT
5 | 15,000 | 180 USDT
6 | 20,000 | 200 USDT
7 | 25,000 | 230 USDT
8 | 30,000 | 300 USDT
9 | 35,000 | 350 USDT
10 | 38,000 | 380 USDT
## Terms & Conditions
- Trade LISTAUSDT Perpetual Futures during the campaign. Cumulative trading volume includes both opening and closing orders, as well as Long and Short positions.
- Unlock trading volume milestones to earn Futures Coupon rewards. Higher cumulative trading volume unlocks higher reward tiers.
- Rewards from all unlocked tiers are cumulative. For example, if a user reaches 10,000 USDT in cumulative LISTAUSDT Futures trading volume, they will unlock the corresponding milestone and receive the total rewards from all unlocked tiers.
- Complete campaign tasks to earn additional rewards, including Cumulative Deposit Tasks, First LISTAUSDT Futures Trade, and Invite Friends.
- Each eligible user can receive up to 2,130 USDT in total rewards during the campaign. Rewards will be distributed automatically based on completed tasks and unlocked trading milestones.
- Only filled orders count toward trading volume. Cancelled orders will not be counted.
- Futures Coupons may be used as trading margin. Profits generated using Futures Coupons are withdrawable, while the coupons themselves are non-withdrawable.
- Fraudulent activities, including self-trading, wash trading, or any form of market manipulation, are strictly prohibited and will result in disqualification.
- Biconomy reserves the right to the final interpretation of this campaign.
